description: Lightweight and flexible command-line JSON processor.

option.name: --version
tip: Show the version.
Terminates argument processing;

global_option.name: --arg
tip: Set $name to the string value;

global_option.name: --argjson
tip: Set $name to the JSON value;

global_option.name: --args
tip: Consume remaining arguments as positional string values;

global_option.name: --ascii-output
tip: Output strings by only ASCII characters using escape sequences;

global_option.name: --binary
tip: Open input/output streams in binary mode;

global_option.name: --build-configuration
tip: Show jq's build configuration;

global_option.name: --color-output
tip: Colorize JSON output;

global_option.name: --compact-output
tip: Compact instead of pretty-printed output;

global_option.name: --exit-status
tip: Set exit status code based on the output;

global_option.name: --from-file
tip: Load the filter from a file;

global_option.name: --help
tip: Show the help.

global_option.name: --indent
tip: Use n spaces for indentation (max 7 spaces);

global_option.name: --join-output
tip: Implies -r and output without newline after each output;

global_option.name: --jsonargs
tip: Consume remaining arguments as positional JSON values;

global_option.name: --library-path
tip: Search modules from the directory;

global_option.name: --monochrome-output
tip: Disable colored output;

global_option.name: --null-input
tip: Use `null` as the single input value.

global_option.name: --raw-input
tip: Read each line as string instead of JSON;

global_option.name: --raw-output
tip: Output strings without escapes and quotes;

global_option.name: --raw-output0
tip: Implies -r and output NUL after each output;

global_option.name: --rawfile
tip: Set $name to string contents of file;

global_option.name: --seq
tip: Parse input/output as application/json-seq;

global_option.name: --slurp
tip: Read all inputs into an array and use it as the single input value;

global_option.name: --slurpfile
tip: Set $name to an array of JSON values read from the file;

global_option.name: --sort-keys
tip: Sort keys of each object on output;

global_option.name: --stream
tip: Parse the input value in streaming fashion;

global_option.name: --stream-errors
tip: Implies --stream and report parse error as an array;

global_option.name: --tab
tip: Use tabs for indentation;

global_option.name: --unbuffered
tip: Flush output stream after each output;
